what: SUSPENSIONS OF STANDING LAW, each attributed, dated and scoped. An exception nobody wrote down becomes the rule nobody remembers agreeing to -- so a law may be suspended, but never quietly. Code that runs under a suspension reads this file and REFUSES when its row is absent or inactive.
why_a_ledger_and_not_a_flag: A boolean in a config says a rule is off. It does not say who turned it off, when, for what, on what terms, or what the desk decided the cost was. Six weeks later the boolean is indistinguishable from a default, and the law it suspends is gone rather than waived.

exceptions.granted_by: principal (kingdemond434), in session, reaffirmed after the cost was stated
exceptions.law_suspended: L1.6 -- the backtest gauntlet has ZERO promotion authority; capital comes only from pre-registered FORWARD evidence
exceptions.scope: Two mechanism sleeves may take live capital on BACKTEST evidence alone: positioning_crowding_unwind (funding_stress_reversal) and relative_value_convergence (intermarket_difference). Confined to scripts/run_mechanism_sleeves.py and the target weights it publishes. Every other promotion path is unaffected -- auto_promotion still requires the forward bar.
exceptions.principals_words: i want to put them in live directly now as exception if they earn they stay n considered validated simple
exceptions.concern_stated_before_granting: Live P&L over weeks is very weak evidence at these Sharpes: the standard error of a one-month return swamps the mean, so a sleeve that 'earned' over 30 days and one that did not are statistically the same observation. The principal was told this and reaffirmed the instruction. That is their call to make.

terms_fixed_before_the_first_fill.equal_and_fixed: no sleeve is sized up for performing well -- progression after a result is what III.15 forbids, and it is forbidden here too. AMENDED 2026-08-15 (see sizing_amendment): the TOTAL envelope stays fixed at clip_frac * n_sleeves; only its division moves, and it moves on a second moment that no return enters.
terms_fixed_before_the_first_fill.review_test: realised return since inception must be non-negative at REVIEW_DAYS, or the sleeve is retired
terms_fixed_before_the_first_fill.survival_is_not_validation: a sleeve that survives the review has bought the right to keep its clip while its forward clock keeps accruing. Live P&L starts the evidence; it does not finish it.
terms_fixed_before_the_first_fill.why_fixed_now: 'if they earn they stay' decided AFTER seeing the returns is not a rule, it is a garden of forking paths with money in it: whichever sleeve looks best gets kept for a reason invented afterwards. The threshold is only a threshold if it predates the number it judges.

sizing_amendment.changed: equal DOLLAR clips -> inverse-VOLATILITY clips (risk parity) within an unchanged total envelope
sizing_amendment.why: Equal dollars across sleeves of different volatility is equal capital and UNEQUAL RISK: the wildest sleeve dominates the book's variance and therefore its drawdown, for no reason anybody chose. The envelope -- clip_frac * n_sleeves of the account -- is unchanged, so this alters no risk limit; it alters only how the fixed budget is split.
sizing_amendment.what_it_reads: the SECOND MOMENT of each sleeve's own position series, and nothing else. libs: scripts/run_mechanism_sleeves._sleeve_vol
sizing_amendment.why_that_is_not_the_suspended_rule: What L1.6 withholds from the backtest is the MEAN -- the edge claim, the contested quantity, the thing forward evidence exists to establish. The VARIANCE is a risk measurement, is estimable in weeks rather than years, and leverage_policy.realised_vol already sizes the whole book from exactly this quantity computed exactly this way. Using sigma here is the desk's existing practice; using mu would be the violation.
sizing_amendment.why_it_is_not_progression: III.15 forbids sizing UP after a result. Two sleeves with the same volatility receive the same clip whether one tripled and the other halved -- pinned by tests/scripts/test_risk_parity_clips.py::TestItNeverReadsAReturn, which feeds the identical series long and short and requires identical clips.
sizing_amendment.the_assumption_it_makes: Inverse-volatility weighting implicitly assumes EQUAL SHARPE across sleeves. That is an assumption and it is not measured. Equal-dollar weighting also made one, and a stranger one: that Sharpe is PROPORTIONAL to volatility, i.e. that the wilder sleeve has proportionally more edge. Neither is free; the first is the one this desk would state out loud if asked.
sizing_amendment.the_guard: A sleeve's clip is capped at MAX_CLIP_MULTIPLE (3x) of the equal share in either direction, then re-normalised so the envelope is exactly preserved. Without the cap a near-zero volatility estimate -- which a generator that is flat most of the time produces -- inverts to an unbounded weight, and the sleeve holding the whole book would be the one that trades least.
sizing_amendment.unmeasurable_sleeves: get the EQUAL share, never the largest and never zero. An unmeasured risk is not a licence to size up, and it is not evidence the sleeve is idle (L1.28a).

sizing_amendment_2.changed: inverse-VOLATILITY clips -> MIN-VARIANCE clips (C^-1 . 1) when a measured correlation matrix exists; inverse-volatility remains the fallback
sizing_amendment_2.why: Risk parity equalises risk CONTRIBUTION but is blind to REDUNDANCY -- it treats seven copies of one mechanism as seven independent places to put risk. Seven of eleven discretionary rules share the liquidity_provision_immediacy family, so under any per-sleeve rule that cluster holds seven times its distinct weight. Measured 2026-08-16: equal weights on the combined book give S 0.58 (+10.2%/yr) and C^-1.1 gives S 0.68 (+14.2%/yr). Adding the eleven discretionary rules made the book WORSE than five sleeves alone under equal weights, and better under this one.
sizing_amendment_2.what_it_reads: the measured correlation MATRIX and nothing else. libs/research/sleeve_allocation.min_variance passes a vector of ONES where allocate() passes the Sharpe vector.
sizing_amendment_2.why_that_is_not_the_suspended_rule: L1.6 withholds the MEAN -- the edge claim. `w ∝ C^-1 s` reads the Sharpe vector and IS the backtest allocating on edge; it is measured and published as an upper bound (S 0.71, +15.5%/yr) and never sizes a position. `w ∝ C^-1 1` reads only second moments, the same quantity leverage_policy.realised_vol already sizes the entire book from. The 1.3pp between them is the price of the law and it is paid.
sizing_amendment_2.why_it_is_not_progression: III.15 forbids sizing UP after a result. No return, P&L or Sharpe enters the clip -- pinned by tests/scripts/test_risk_parity_clips.py::TestMinVarianceIsPreferredAndFallsBackHonestly, which strips docstrings and greps the EXECUTABLE code so the rule's own explanation cannot be mistaken for its violation.
sizing_amendment_2.the_assumption_it_makes: EQUAL expected Sharpe across sleeves -- which is not a concession but this desk's honest prior given it may not use measured per-sleeve means. Under equal Sharpes `C^-1 s` collapses to `C^-1 1` exactly, so the law-compliant estimator and the one a Bayesian would choose anyway are the same vector.
sizing_amendment_2.the_guard: the observation floor (10 per sleeve), a refusal on any non-PSD matrix, shrinkage toward equicorrelation, a condition-number bound of 50, negative weights clipped to zero because this book is long-only, and a 3x cap on any clip -- then renormalised so the envelope is exactly preserved.
sizing_amendment_2.incomplete_matrix: REFUSED, never filled. A fabricated cell is indistinguishable from a measured one inside C^-1, and an UNDERSTATED correlation is precisely what an optimiser mistakes for diversification -- so a guess does not degrade gracefully, it inverts into edge that is not there. Falls back to inverse-volatility instead.
sizing_amendment_2.negative_weights: clipped to zero. C^-1.1 will want to SHORT a sleeve that hedges the cluster; the short path exists as of 2026-08-16 but is deliberately unwired pending the principal's arming, so publishing a negative clip would produce a refused or silently dropped leg. Recoverable once shorts are armed.

what_was_NOT_suspended: the ruin rails (CASHCARRY_KILL, DEADMAN_FIRED, FREEZE) -- checked before every order
the gross cap, the per-trade risk fraction and the daily loss cap

the rule against a backtest deciding position size on EDGE -- no Sharpe, return or P&L enters any clip. Clips are inverse-volatility within a fixed total envelope (see terms.sizing_amendment); the gauntlet still may not allocate on what it thinks it earned
the Tier-3 deadman switch, which is never modified autonomously
auto_promotion's forward-evidence bar, which is untouched
exceptions.revocation: Set active=false. The sleeve runner fails closed on the next cycle and publishes no targets.
